owner_station_side_time_ordered_holdout.claim_boundary: Same-site station-side pressure, cascade and recharge diagnostics only; no vehicle-side or field-safety claim.

public_type_iv_component_holdout.claim_boundary: Independent external receiving-tank component evidence only; no station controller, dispenser, ESD, vehicle or field-safety claim.

search_boundary: pressure, temperature and mass-flow or transferred-mass fields
station_to_vehicle_public_search.paper_limitation: No openly reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw trace was identified; vehicle-side controller/ESD and complete full-loop field validation are outside the claim boundary.
station_to_vehicle_public_search.optional_reentry: Custodian-provided, de-identified, synchronized events may be frozen and evaluated as a separately scoped extension.

ethics_and_expert_evaluation.ethics_meaning: Institutional determination of approval, exemption or not-required status for a human-facing study.
ethics_and_expert_evaluation.expert_meaning: Independent blinded qualified reviewers score SAGA versus alarm-only responses for action correctness, priority, stabilization, prevention, grounding, usability and unsafe omissions; no LLM-as-judge.
